body:
[aida:advisor] STANDING INSTRUCTION, effective now, until BUG-1531 lands.

DO NOT RUN `aida pr ship` ON ANY BRANCH MATCHING pr* — not pr-N, not prN, not
pr<N>-review. Do not follow an `aida pr ship <branch>` hint from `aida awaiting`'s
unshipped_work table for any such branch, whatever the row's spec id says.

WHY, verified four ways at 22:13 rather than reasoned:

  pr2035-review head       7a4c4f52eceeffd9df698ed4d72fe1bb3205bab0
  PR #2035 head            7a4c4f52eceeffd9df698ed4d72fe1bb3205bab0   identical
  BUG-1470.json            verdict request-changes, reviewed_sha 7a4c4f52ecee
  merge-hold markers       keyed PER PR NUMBER (PR-1972, PR-1974, ...)

`aida pr ship` with no <N> CREATES a PR via gh pr create if none exists. A new PR gets a
new number, therefore no hold marker and no aida:merge-hold label, therefore a GREEN
merge-hold-gate — for the exact commit a reviewer refused. The squash then carries the
spec trailer and `aida pull` auto-bumps the spec to Completed.

Three of the affected rows are snapshots of PRs under live reviewer holds: #2035, and
#2042/#2043 from the 18:52/18:53 branch-crossing holds. The surface is currently
offering a hold-free path around three separate refusals, in a field labelled
"recovery".

ONE LEG IS UNVERIFIED ON PURPOSE: whether gh pr create's push succeeds non-interactively
from a local-only branch. That is the difference between a bypass and a near-miss and it
is not worth executing to find out. Treat it as a bypass.

THIS IS A PROSE RULE, WHICH IS THE WEAK FORM. The real fix is BUG-1531 criteria 2 and 3
— no ship hint for a head that already has an open PR, and no ship hint for a head
carrying an unresolved RequestChanges verdict. Until one of those is code, this
instruction is all that stands between the hint and the bypass, and a prose rule is
exactly what we keep filing bugs about relying on.

Normal `aida pr ship <N>` against a real PR number is unaffected. The hazard is the
bare-branch form on a snapshot ref.
subject: STANDING INSTRUCTION: do not run 'aida pr ship' on any pr* branch until BUG-1531 lands — the hint bypasses merge holds
